description: Travelling model to simulate the mobility behavior of people walking and cycling from selected starts and stops in the area of Hamburg Harburg.

config.description: The global configuration used to parameterize all settings of the scenarios, allowing to override each configuration and used resource.
config.title: An optional scenario configuration to override each setting.

cycleTravelerLayer.description: Cycle traveler event layer, spawning new agents with source and target

endTime.description: The end time when this spawn event ends to occur.
endTime.title: Event End Time

gender.description: The biological gender with impact on the walking speed
gender.title: Gender

gradient.description: The speed gradient to determine the speed change
gradient.title: Gradient

hasOwnBikeProbability.description: The probability of the spawned agent to owning a personal bike instead of using a rental one.
hasOwnBikeProbability.title: Bike Owner Probability

mass.description: The mass of the traveler with impact on the walking speed
mass.title: Mass

spawningAmount.description: The amount of agents to spawn for each occured event.
spawningAmount.title: Spawning Amount

spawningIntervalInMinutes.description: The interval in minutes how often this events occur between the start and end.
spawningIntervalInMinutes.title: Spawning Interval

startTime.description: The start time when this spawn event occurs.
startTime.title: Event Start Time

cycleTravelerLayer.title: Cycle Traveler Agent Layer

endPoint.description: The time point when the simulation end internally. Specified as ISO 8601 format
endPoint.title: The concrete end datetime of the simulation time to calculate

rentalBicycle.description: Different types of used rental bicycle types

maxAcceleration.description: The maximum acceleration of this bike.
maxAcceleration.title: Max Acceleration

maxDeceleration.description: The maximum deceleration of this bike.
maxDeceleration.title: Max  Deceleration

maxSpeed.description: The maximum speed of this bike.
maxSpeed.title: Max Speed

type.description: The bike type name e.g., electric bike or pedelec
type.title: Bike Type

rentalBicycle.title: Rental Bike Types

rentalStations.description: Different stations within the simulation, used rental bicycles for movement
rentalStations.title: Rental Bicycle Stations

roadNetwork.description: The input network used to represent the environment where the agents can move on

lanes.description: The count of lanes of this road segment
lanes.title: Lanes

roadNetwork.title: Moving Network Environment

startPoint.description: The time point when the simulation starts internally. Specified as ISO 8601 format
startPoint.title: The concrete start datetime of the simulation time to calculate

steps.description: The amount of steps in seconds to simulate used instead of end time point, starting from start time point
steps.title: The amount of steps in seconds to simulate.

schema.title: Point-based output of each agent and their values with different simulation times.

schema.description: The time series of average amount of agents on each road of the selected area.
schema.title: Time series of average road occupation

schema.description: The time series of usage of current active modality of all agents.
schema.title: The time series of active modality.

title: SOH - Green4Bikes Model
